annotations.title: Read one page of an extraction's source datasheet

description: Read one page of the source datasheet behind an extraction job as positioned text tokens (text and box in PDF points), in reading windows of at most 1500 tokens (token_offset / next_token_offset). Carries the page's census: text_token_count, vector_path_count, raster_image_count. textless=true means no positioned text (a drawing, a scan, or an old map), not a blank page; payload_elided=true means the page's tokens were dropped to fit the document budget, so read text_token_count. Drawings and images are not served here. Pages are the PDF's physical 1-based pages. Deterministic: reads the stored document map, calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key; readable jobs are your own, your workspace's TEAM-shared jobs and PUBLIC jobs, as on the REST API.

job_id.description: An extraction job in your account (or shared with it).

token_limit.description: Tokens to return. Default 400, at most 1500.

token_offset.description: Skip this many tokens (from next_token_offset). Default 0.
